definitions.explanation: a chronic respiratory condition characterized by difficulty breathing, wheezing, and coughing, caused by inflammation and narrowing of the airways

examples.japanese: {喘息|ぜんそく}の{発作|ほっさ}が{起|お}きた。
{子供|こども}の{頃|ころ}から{喘息|ぜんそく}を{持|も}っている。
{喘息|ぜんそく}の{薬|くすり}を{常備|じょうび}している。
examples.english: I always keep asthma medication on hand.

notes:
MEDICAL TERM:
{喘|ぜん} (wheeze, pant) + {息|そく} (breath).

TYPES:
- {気管支喘息|きかんしぜんそく} (bronchial asthma)
- アレルギー{性|せい}{喘息|ぜんそく} (allergic asthma)
- {小児喘息|しょうにぜんそく} (childhood asthma)

TRIGGERS:
- {花粉|かふん} (pollen)
- ダニ (dust mites)
- {煙|けむり} (smoke)
- {運動|うんどう} (exercise)

RELATED:
- {吸入器|きゅうにゅうき} (inhaler)
- {発作|ほっさ} (attack)
